games.title: Soccer
games.body_html:
“Soccer” by KIDSjumpTECH is an exciting interactive game where players score goals in virtual nets – enhancing coordination, reaction time, and accuracy. This game transforms any space into a dynamic playing field, encouraging physical activity and teamwork. It’s perfect for schools, children’s centers, and sports zones, making activities both engaging and beneficial.

Soccer With The Interactive Projector

Soccer by KIDSjumpTECH is designed specifically for interactive projectors that turn any flat surface into an interactive playing field. Motion capture technology allows players to control the ball and interact with virtual nets in real-time, creating a fully immersive experience and making the game dynamic and engaging.

KIDSjumpTECH offers state-of-the-art interactive projectors, ideal for creating gaming areas, educational spaces, and entertainment zones. Easy installation and setup make this equipment accessible for schools, development centers, and spaces that value the combination of physical activity and innovative technology.

How to Play

KIDSjumpTECH’s Soccer game challenges participants to test their skills in scoring goals into virtual nets. Players are given five attempts, each displayed as soccer balls on the screen. As attempts are used, they disappear, providing visual feedback. The goal is to make the most of all five tries to achieve the best score.

The game is projected onto a surface using an interactive projector equipped with motion sensors, allowing players to interact with the virtual environment in real-time. This setup is widely used in educational institutions, entertainment centers, and other venues that value a blend of learning and active leisure.

Soccer enhances coordination, agility, and reaction time while boosting physical activity. It’s suitable for various age groups and skill levels, making it a versatile tool for entertainment and education.

Benefits of Playing

Improves Coordination.

Enhances the ability to synchronize body movements with visual and tactile stimuli.

Boosts Reaction Time.

Quick decision-making and rapid responses to the virtual ball improve reflexes and cognitive speed.

Encourages Physical Activity.

Keeps participants moving, promoting endurance and muscle strength.

Develops Accuracy.

Trains precise movements and control over the force applied to achieve goals.

Provides a Safe Environment.

Projection-based gameplay eliminates the risk of physical injuries.

Fosters Social Interaction.

Encourages teamwork and sportsmanship in group settings.

Reduces Stress.

Engaging gameplay helps participants relax and unwind.

Accessible for All Ages:

Adjustable difficulty and versatile gameplay make Soccer enjoyable for kids and adults alike.

Installation Locations

Clinics and Medical Facilities.

Soccer helps distract children in waiting rooms or calms them before procedures, reducing stress. It can also be part of therapy focused on coordination, motor skills, and attention.

Exhibitions and Events.

The game quickly becomes a centerpiece of activity, engaging participants with its interactivity and excitement—ideal for events where audience involvement is key.

Educational Institutions.

Perfect for school gyms or recreation areas to maintain children’s physical activity and foster a competitive spirit.

Children’s Entertainment Centers.

The game captivates kids of all ages, becoming a popular feature in play areas. It creates a fun atmosphere and promotes interaction.

Sensory Rooms.

Soccer engages children in active interaction with their surroundings, aiding attention and reaction development.

Gyms and Sports Clubs.

Suitable for group or individual training, offering a fun way to enhance coordination and maintain fitness.

Hotels and Resorts.

A great addition to play zones and kids’ programs, attracting families and providing children with an active, enjoyable pastime.

Home Use.

Soccer is a perfect activity for the whole family, giving kids an exciting way to play at home.

Compatible Equipment

Soccer is compatible with the Interactive Wall and Interactive Mobile Wall. These are innovative systems that turn walls into dynamic gaming surfaces, equipped with high-resolution laser projectors and motion sensors. These systems ensure that the reactions to player movements are instantaneous. The mobile version is easy to transport and install, making it ideal for various spaces.

Along with the equipment, more than 10 additional games from the Interactive Sports category are provided, including educational, relaxing, and active options. This variety makes the systems suitable for educational, entertainment, and sports purposes.

games.title: Lava
games.body_html:
“Lava” by KIDSjumpTECH is an innovative interactive game that promotes physical activity by combining gaming mechanics with educational elements. Lava is not just entertaining—it also supports the holistic development of essential skills for children at a young age. This makes it an ideal addition to schools, children’s centers, and entertainment complexes.

Lava With The Interactive Projector

The Lava game is specifically designed for use with an interactive projector, transforming any flat surface into a dynamic play area. Using motion-tracking technology, players interact with the virtual environment in real time, making the gameplay highly engaging and realistic.

KIDSjumpTECH specializes in developing and manufacturing interactive projectors, perfectly suited for play spaces, educational settings, and active leisure. We offer state-of-the-art equipment that is easy to install and set up, making it an essential tool for schools, children’s centers, and other educational spaces.

How to Play

Here’s how the gameplay works:

Game Start.

The projector displays a game field with stone platforms and streams of lava.

Movement Begins.

Players move across the virtual surface, trying to step only on stone blocks and avoid the “lava.”

Increasing Challenge.

With each level, new challenges arise. For example, blocks disappear faster, and the distances between them increase, requiring more precision and quicker reactions.

Objective.

Complete all levels without falling into the “lava” to become the winner.

Lava is perfect for active play, developing focus, agility, and strategic thinking. The game offers various difficulty levels, making it enjoyable for both beginners and experienced players.

Benefits of the Game

Encourages children to stay active, helping to combat sedentary lifestyles.
Enhances fine and gross motor skills through precise movements.
Teaches players to synchronize body movements with visual and tactile stimuli, improving coordination.
Provides a safe virtual environment for skill development without the risk of injury.
The engaging gameplay allows parents to either relax or actively join in with their kids.
Projection technology enables the game field to adapt to different spaces and participant ages.
Supports teamwork modes, fostering communication and collaboration skills.
Fun and active gameplay helps kids relieve stress and improve their mood.

Install Anywhere

Sensory Rooms.

This game has universal appeal, suitable for children of all ages. Its simple “don’t touch the lava” concept is immediately engaging. In sensory rooms, it serves as both a playful element and a tool to keep participants focused and actively engaged with the environment.

Educational Institutions.

Bright visuals, intuitive interfaces, and opportunities for competition make Lava appealing for both younger and older students. It’s a natural addition to active recreation spaces and school gyms, encouraging kids to stay involved in learning and play.

Children’s Entertainment Centers.

The game attracts a wide age range, making it versatile for family fun. Its interactive elements draw attention, inspiring children to enjoy group play on the playground.

Exhibitions and Events.

Lava becomes a focal point, encouraging participants to compete or actively engage with the space. This high level of interaction makes it especially valuable for events aimed at capturing visitor attention and creating positive impressions.

Clinics and Medical Facilities.

In waiting areas or therapy rooms, the game serves as a tool to entertain and distract children, reducing stress levels. It helps kids relax before procedures and can also be part of physical or play therapy to improve motor skills, coordination, and focus.

Fitness Centers and Sports Clubs.

With its flexibility, Lava is suitable for both individual workouts and group activities, offering participants an engaging way to stay active.

Hotels and Resorts.

Lava is an excellent way to entertain children in playrooms or animation programs, enhancing appeal to families.

Home Use.

Lava is a perfect solution for family leisure, keeping children active and entertained in a home setting.

Equipment Compatibility

The Lava game is compatible with the Interactive Floor and Interactive Mobile Floor systems, which transform any flat surface into an interactive space using projection and motion-tracking technology. These systems offer mobility, easy installation and setup, and adaptability to various spaces.

In addition to Lava, the devices come with more than 10 other games in the Interactive Floor category, including educational, relaxing, and active options. This makes the equipment not only entertaining but also versatile for various purposes.
